about: Test vectors for passkey approvals (spec/action-records-v1.md, section 10). Generated by testvectors/generate.py from the Python reference implementation with a deterministic software authenticator; every key is derived from a public seed, never use one for real. A case is a trail (records in order, each with its CID), the principals file the auditor trusts, and the problems a verifier must report, in order (none means the approvals verify), and the notes it makes.

cose_keys.name: wrong curve
cose_keys.expect_error: the key is not on the P-256 curve

cose_keys.name: not on the curve
cose_keys.expect_error: the key is not a point on the P-256 curve

cose_keys.name: coordinates not reduced
cose_keys.expect_error: the key's coordinates are not reduced

cose_keys.name: EdDSA small order
cose_keys.expect_error: the key is of small order

cose_keys.name: EdDSA on Ed448
cose_keys.expect_error: the key is not on the Ed25519 curve

cose_keys.name: unsupported algorithm
cose_keys.expect_error: the key's algorithm -257 is not supported (ES256 and EdDSA are)

cose_keys.name: truncated
cose_keys.expect_error: the key: the CBOR is truncated

cose_keys.name: empty
cose_keys.expect_error: the key is empty or too long

assertions.name: client data changed
assertions.expect_error: the client data's challenge is not base64url

assertions.name: another origin
assertions.expect_error: the origin is not the one enrolled for this passkey

assertions.name: another relying party
assertions.expect_error: the relying party id hash is not the one enrolled for this passkey

assertions.name: sign counter that never moves (a synced passkey) is accepted
extension data that is one canonical map
extension data that is not exactly one map

assertions.name: extension flag with no extension data
assertions.expect_error: the extension data is not canonical CBOR: the CBOR is truncated

assertions.name: client data with a repeated key
assertions.expect_error: the client data is not JSON without repeated keys

assertions.name: cross-origin client data
assertions.expect_error: the assertion was made in a cross-origin context
